mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.team_invitations (id, team_id, invited_email, invited_by, role, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{teamId}, #{invitedEmail}, #{invitedBy}, #{role, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{token}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (team_id, invited_email) WHERE status = 'PENDING' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, team_id, invited_email, invited_by, role, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.team_invitations WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, team_id, invited_email, invited_by, role, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.team_invitations WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, team_id, invited_email, invited_by, role, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.team_invitations WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
